titel: Put your name on a 3D print with Blender ✍️ #blender #3dprinting

eind.zin: A new Blender tip for 3D printing every week.

printzin: Measured in Blender, not print tested by us yet.

scenes.tekst: Want your name on a 3D print? Here is how, in Blender.
scenes.label: QUICK TIP

scenes.tekst: Open the Add menu and click Text.
scenes.label: STEP 1

scenes.tekst: It is only 1 mm tall. Press S, type 20, Enter.
scenes.uitspraak: It is only one millimeter tall. Press S, type twenty, Enter.
scenes.label: STEP 2

scenes.tekst: Press Tab, delete the word, type your name, then Tab again.
scenes.label: STEP 3

scenes.tekst: Now look from the side. The text is flat, zero thickness, so there is nothing to print.
scenes.label: WHY

scenes.tekst: Press Tab, A, then E, type 3, Enter.
scenes.uitspraak: Press Tab, A, then E, type three, Enter.
scenes.label: STEP 5

scenes.tekst: Now every letter is 3 mm thick. Press N and check the Dimensions.
scenes.uitspraak: Now every letter is three millimeters thick. Press N and check the Dimensions.
scenes.label: RESULT

scenes.tekst: Export it as STL and open it in your slicer.
scenes.label: TIP

scenes.tekst: Measured in Blender, not print tested by us yet. Save this for your next print.
scenes.label: HONEST

scenes.uitspraak: More Blender tips for three D printing, at dortus dot com slash Y T.
